pluginArguments.description: The arguments that are passed to the `fn` function of the plugin definition.

keys.description: The keys (references) to different types of chart internals.

COMPONENT.description:
The unique keys of the existing components available in the legend chart.
Useful if you want to extend or override existing components.

LEGEND.description: The categorical legend component (`legend-cat`). Present when `color.mode` is `"byDimension"` or when `color.mode` is `"byExpression"` with `legend.expressionTarget="dimension"`.

LEGEND_SEQ.description: The sequential gradient legend component (`legend-seq`). Present when `color.mode` is `"byMeasure"` or when `color.mode` is `"byExpression"` with `legend.expressionTarget="measure"`.

BRUSH_LEGEND_RANGE.description: The brush-range interaction overlay for the sequential legend. Enables range selections on the gradient legend.

SCALE.description:
The scales associated with the legend chart.
Useful if you want to add a component that uses the same scale.

FILL.description: The primary fill color scale. For `byDimension` and `byMeasure` modes this is the color service scale. For `byExpression+measure` this is a `sequential-color` scale built from expression values.

FILL_RANGE.description: The range scale for the sequential gradient legend. Maps measure values to the gradient extent. Present when `color.mode` is `"byMeasure"` or `"byExpression"` with `legend.expressionTarget="measure"`.

LEGEND_EXPR_FILL.description: A categorical fill scale built from expression color values. Present when `color.mode` is `"byExpression"` with `legend.expressionTarget="dimension"`. Extracts colors from `qDimensionInfo/0` attribute expressions.

layout.description: The layout from the enigma model.

getPluginArgs.description: Prepare important chart internals for the users to build their own plugins.

returns.description: Chart internals that will be exposed to the users.
